title: The Reinvention

shots.image: curriculum documents and colourful assessment sheets on a desk, {DESIGNER}'s hands arranging them, close view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: From 2022, my journey entered a completely new phase.

shots.image: {DESIGNER} walking into a bright modern office with plants and large windows, seen from behind
shots.motion: she walks to her desk with a laptop bag

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I moved into full-fledged instructional design and curriculum development.

shots.image: {DESIGNER} at a large planning wall covered with colourful sticky notes and storyboard cards, side view
shots.motion: she moves a sticky note and connects ideas

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I began working on curriculum mapping, assessment development, storyboarding and academic strategy.

shots.image: {DESIGNER} at a desk with several screens showing colourful maths diagrams, reading materials and science illustrations, seen over her shoulder
shots.sfx: keyboard typing, mouse clicks, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: My projects expanded across Mathematics, English Language Arts and Science.

shots.image: {DESIGNER} leading a meeting around a table with {TEAM}, documents and laptops, side view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I started leading and coordinating subject matter experts and contributing to College and Career Readiness projects.

shots.image: a team member at the meeting table pointing at an assessment document, {DESIGNER} listening, side view

lines.speaker: TEAM_MEMBER
lines.text: Should we map the assessment against the standards?

shots.image: {DESIGNER} nodding and tapping the document thoughtfully, side view

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: Yes. Every question needs a clear learning purpose.

shots.image: a colleague handing {DESIGNER} a printed document across the table, both smiling, side view
{DESIGNER} reviewing a storyboard on a tablet, warm afternoon light, side view
shots.sfx: tablet taps, office ambience, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was no longer just creating lessons.

shots.image: {DESIGNER} working with a small team around a table, camera widening to reveal a collaborative academic workspace
shots.motion: the camera slowly pulls back and widens
shots.sfx: office ambience, soft conversation, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was helping design meaningful learning experiences.
